cells.quote: Table (3) indicated that the differences in means between experimental group and control group were not statistically significant (α=0.05).
cells.note: The pretest means were 54.74 for the control group and 54.89 for the experimental group; the reported teaching-strategy result was F = 0.001, p = 0.98. The study used a quasi-experimental design with randomly selected sections, not random assignment of students.
